Thank you both for those important findings. Let me summarize where we stand on each agenda item before I can sign off.

First, on the status-report entries: Neither of you has actually submitted your recorded entry yet. Jonah, your sound survey report is still awaiting upload. Elena, your rights confirmation has not yet been entered in the event file. Per the standard production meeting requirements, I need both recorded status-report entries submitted before I can sign off on the plan. So that item is not yet complete.

Second, on the microphone setup: Jonah, your RF survey finding is clear — wireless microphones are unreliable in the courtyard due to interference from the neighboring broadcast compound, and you're recommending exactly four wired microphones. That aligns with the four-speaker Q&A we're planning. I'm prepared to approve four wired microphones once your report is uploaded.

Third, on the recording format: Elena, you've confirmed the appearance release permits audio-only recording and prohibits public video release. Since the Q&A is already planned for podcast feed release, an audio-only recording format appears consistent with the rights clearance. However, I don't have a specific recording format proposal on the table yet from the sound side. Jonah, can you confirm the recording format you plan to use — file type, sample rate, etc.?

Fourth, on the podcast release date: Elena, your finding is that the filmmaker's representative confirmed the podcast episode can be released only on September 15, 2026. That's a firm date from the rights side. I'm prepared to approve September 15, 2026 as the release date once your documentation is entered.

So before I can settle and sign off, I need two things: (1) both of you to complete and submit your recorded status-report entries, and (2) Jonah to confirm the recording format specification. Once those are in, I can approve the full plan. Can we move forward on those items now?
